# councilof.ai

> Byzantine-Fault-Tolerant AI governance. councilof.ai runs multi-agent consensus
> councils that vote on AI decisions before they act — cryptographically signed,
> EU AI Act-aligned, sovereign. Built by CSOAI LTD (UK 16939677).

## What it does
- BFT consensus over agent proposals (no single agent can act unchecked)
- Compliance-by-design governance (EU AI Act, ISO 42001)
- Signed, auditable verdicts (Ed25519 attestation)
